user.title: Sign in to SEMS Portal
user.description: Use the same email and password you use in the GoodWe SEMS Portal app — the one you check your solar in. Your charger is found automatically; there is no serial number to look up.

charger.title: Which charger?
charger.description: This account has more than one. Choose the one you want in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to SEMS Portal again

error.invalid_auth: That email and password were not accepted. They are your SEMS Portal details — check they work in the SEMS Portal app and try again.
error.cannot_connect: SEMS Portal could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.no_chargers: Signed in successfully, but no EV charger is listed on this account. Check the charger appears in your SEMS Portal app.

abort.already_configured: That charger is already set up.
abort.reauth_entry_missing: The existing SEMS EV CONNECT setup could not be found.
